title: zeroboot: Sub-millisecond VM sandboxes for AI agents via copy-on-write forking
description:
zeroboot creates isolated sandboxes for AI agents by booting a Firecracker microVM once, snapshotting its memory and CPU state, and then forking new KVM virtual machines from that snapshot with copy-on-write memory mappings. Each fork is a separate KVM virtual machine with hardware-enforced memory isolation. The project reports sub-millisecond fork latency and a few hundred kilobytes of memory per sandbox on its published benchmark; see the repository README for the measurement and its limitations.

Written in Rust. Includes an HTTP API and Python and TypeScript SDKs.
